description: FloPy is the Python package developed by the US Geological Survey and collaborators for creating, running and processing MODFLOW-family groundwater models. It supports MODFLOW 6 and several earlier variants, plus MODPATH, MT3D and SEAWAT. Users define grids, hydraulic properties, boundary conditions, stress periods and output settings; the interface writes model inputs and reads heads, budgets and flow results for analysis or plotting. Geographic coverage and temporal detail are user-defined. Public source and Python packages are free under a US public-domain notice and worldwide CC0-1.0 dedication. A limitation is that groundwater solver executables are separate from the Python interface, and supported packages and model checks vary by model version. The reviewed development README requires Python 3.11 or newer. FloPy can prepare and examine water-supply or irrigation simulations, including workflows related to the MODFLOW agricultural-water-use package (model-modflow-api-agricultural-water-use-package). Its README gives a complete small-model example and cites 2016 and 2023 workflow papers. No solver, groundwater dataset or model archive was downloaded.
